title: Knowledge base entity
description: One API name the corpus documents, with everything the corpus says about it. Written by tools/build-kb.py to knowledge/kb/entities.jsonl(.gz).

id.description: Canonical lookup key: the name lowercased with '::' and punctuation removed (tools/ce_api_names.py normalize()).

name.description: Display name as a page prints it (the most common one).

layers.description: Which corpus layers document the name.

doc_role.description: DERIVED from the corpus. api-definition: a page prints a syntax block. api-page: a page looks like reference (Header/Library/DLL/OS-version requirements) but prints no syntax block. topic: the name is only the title of a prose page.

kind_evidence.description: Where the kind came from. null when no evidence decided it.

name_evidence.description: How the name was taken from the source pages.

ce_sets.description: Corpus-relative set directories of the CE pages (e.g. learn/windows-embedded-ce-6.0). This is the version scope of the entity.

headers.description: Header names stated by the pages (Header / req.header). Values are quoted, not normalised.

libraries.description: Link libraries stated by the pages (Link Library / Library / req.lib).

dlls.description: DLL names stated by the pages (DLL / req.dll / api_location).

declarations.description: Ids of declarations.jsonl records for this entity (all roles).

syntax_declarations.description: The subset whose role is 'syntax': the entity's own declaration, not a quoted example.

noise.description: DERIVED flag for a name that is not an API. Only one pattern is certain enough to flag: an all-caps double-underscore identifier (__COMMONPUBROOT) that a page's code block mentioned. Flagged records stay in the file (and in reports/coverage.tsv); reports/gaps.tsv skips them.

modules.description: sdk-api module the page belongs to (from the page's UID, e.g. 'fileapi'). The Win32-side grouping; CE pages state no module.

relations.description: DERIVED links to other definitions, each with the evidence it was read from. Every entry is a lead with its page, never a merged claim.

id.description: Canonical id of the target, '' when the relation has no single target (type 'layer').

present.description: Whether that target exists as an entity in this file.

evidence.description: The printed text the relation was read from.

page.description: Corpus-relative page the evidence is on.

generation_use.description: DERIVED, rule-based: which part of an include/def generator this record can feed. include-declaration = a syntax declaration plus a stated header; type-definition = struct/enum/union/typedef; link-library = a function/callback with a stated library or DLL; def-export = a function/callback with a stated DLL; abi-layout = a struct/union whose declaration lists members; unicode-mapping = it has a unicode-ansi relation; version-scope = it names the CE sets that document it; ce-restriction = it has constraint sentences.
